title: Certificate-driven polytope-hull contraction for interval branch and bound: code and data
description: Code and data of the paper. The self-certifying simplex (SC) and the polytope-hull contractor are in examples/dfb of this Ibex fork. results/escalera_2026-11-06 holds the banks of passes, the raw results of every run, the run scripts and the scripts that produce the tables; its README.md explains how to rebuild the binaries and regenerate the tables.
